lecture_title: Magnetic Forces, Vector Potentials, and Gauge Freedom

assets.name: lecture_09_figure_01.png
assets.rationale: The full three-component nabla operator is unobstructed, and the next line begins its action on the scalar temperature field.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: We can now construct a new kind of field called the gradient.
assets.caption_hint: nabla as a vector of spatial derivative operators

assets.name: lecture_09_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: The frame preserves both one cross-product component and the antisymmetric three-by-three board sketch with minimal occlusion.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: And how many components does an anti-symmetric matrix have?

assets.name: lecture_09_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: The completed identity that the divergence of a curl vanishes is centered and fully legible.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The divergence of any curl is equal to zero.

assets.name: lecture_09_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: The north and south sketches are connected by the developing field-line path, matching the hidden-pipe explanation of zero magnetic divergence.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Magnetic field lines come into the south pole and bend around.
assets.caption_hint: closed magnetic flux through a bar magnet

assets.name: lecture_09_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: Both the curl definition of the magnetic field and the gauge shift are fully visible on a sparse board.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Let us talk a little bit about this ambiguity in A.
assets.caption_hint: magnetic field as a curl and gauge shift

assets.name: lecture_09_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: The upper board retains the first choice Ay=bx while the lower board shows the completed second choice Ax=-by, Ay=Az=0.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: These are two different representations of the same magnetic field.
assets.caption_hint: two vector potentials for one uniform magnetic field

assets.name: lecture_09_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: The complete electric-plus-magnetic force is legible while the lecturer points directly to the velocity-cross-field term.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Electric forces can be much stronger than magnetic forces.

assets.name: lecture_09_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: The magnetic force remains visible beside the completed Coriolis expression, making the structural analogy explicit.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The Coriolis force was a similar formula.

assets.name: lecture_09_figure_09.png
assets.rationale: The action and its completed kinetic plus vector-potential integrand are simultaneously visible and unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: If we put A here, then we will get B here.

assets.name: lecture_09_figure_10.png
assets.rationale: The line integral, segmented path, and completed endpoint difference are all visible in the same frame.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: It just gives you S2 minus S1.
assets.caption_hint: gauge variation as an endpoint term
